summary: This guide showcases a fast Radiance and Lightning speedrun team capable of clearing three major dungeons: Grave of Curse, Grave of Rot, and Heretical Ruins. The lineup consists of Anneliesis, Child of Chaos, Bargarn, Guinavivre, and Kurvida. Bargarn uses the Puppeteer set combined with Witch's Remains to land fast debuffs via his short ultimate cooldown. High Attack stats on Kurvida and Child of Chaos maximize the overall damage of main DPS units Guinavivre and Anneliesis, securing 7 to 8 second dungeon clears.

tips: Equip Bargarn with Puppeteer set and Witch's Remains artifact for a 3.9 second initial ultimate.
Restart dungeon runs if Bargarn misses his opening debuff to ensure top speedrun times.
Ensure appropriate food buffs are active prior to attempting fast dungeon clears.
